Roboto Latin variable WOFF2, normal style, weights 100–900 (includes 300/400/500/700).

Official Google Fonts CSS request:
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@100..900&display=swap

Unmodified font downloaded from the Latin section of the official CSS response:
https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/roboto/v51/KFO7CnqEu92Fr1ME7kSn66aGLdTylUAMa3yUBA.woff2

Accompanying license, downloaded unmodified from Google's font repository:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/roboto/OFL.txt

License: SIL Open Font License 1.1
Copyright 2011 The Roboto Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-classic)

google-fonts.css retains the original Google response for provenance.
roboto.css is the self-hosted Latin-only declaration; copy it with the WOFF2 and license.
No external network request is needed when using roboto.css and the accompanying local font.
Other scripts and unsupported characters use the site's fallback font stack.

Verification: valid WOFF2 header and declared byte length; Fontconfig recognized Roboto and
the Thin/ExtraLight/Light/Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold/ExtraBold/Black named instances.
